ns2:section.sectionText: This course is open to juniors and seniors in AgCom and News Editorial journalism. Please note the stated prerequisites. The registration system may allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You will be dropped when pre-reqs are checked.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
